prompt: Run a quick, read-only repository audit on the small snapshot in subject/. There are no independent workers, web access, Git metadata or shell execution. Use audit-run/ directly as the run directory: write audit-run/scope.md and audit-run/report.md at those exact relative paths, with no slug or date subdirectory. Disclose any blocked checks or generation instead of claiming to have run them. Do not edit the subject, record owner decisions, or look elsewhere for more evidence.
terse: Record the audit scope, then inspect the snapshot and report actionable findings. Mark verification as single-context and record independent external checks as not run. Distinguish observed findings from blocked checks.
